notes.title: Harbinger Playtest is now closed, full game launching in October!
notes.notes: Hey guys! I hope you all enjoyed the playtest, I received lots of valuable feedback that has made its way into the final game. The full release of Harbinger will be sometime early in October, I just need to finish up the second arena and some of the later game content, then it'll be done!

notes.title: Harbinger Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! The playtest for Harbinger is out now, it includes about 30 minutes of content to help me iron out bugs before the launch. The final release will have much more content and include all three maps and much more story content, only one map is included in this initial playtest. Please fill out the feedback form found in the bottom right of the main menu after you are done playing! Alternatively, you can DM me on discord with any feedback or join the discord channel, thanks!

[url=https://discord.gg/PzKPQrfZyD]Join the Discord Here![/url]
